task: Recall the latest WRITE symbol among unrelated DISTRACTOR events. Return UNKNOWN when no WRITE has been observed in this scope.
shared_depth_mechanism: Each neural arm has a learned weight-shared residual MLP readout, repeated k times AFTER event encoding. It is trained at k=1,2,4; k=8 is held out. This is NOT a full recurrent Transformer block or a hard multi-hop reasoning task.

baseline_screen.description: Pilot quality screen, not architecture acceptance. Evaluate trained depths 1/2/4 and delays 0/4/16.
baseline_screen.seed_policy: Report every seed; do not discard failures.

fairness: Same generated training batches, targets, teaching count, depths and evaluation observations for neural arms. Parameter count, encoding work, retained representation and wall time differ and are reported, not described as compute matched. Both can retain all tested events; no history truncation in the main comparison.
state_off: At the final QUERY, erase past hidden state/tape for all arms. This is an information-removal control, NOT a strong Transformer comparator. Report UNKNOWN outputs separately; loss of recall here is not an architectural win.
learning: Actual supervised preparation uses AdamW. Evaluation weights are frozen; there is no online learning, delayed-credit learner or trace quantization in this study.
safety: Synthetic observations only. No downloads, external writes, private-data training, NSS live database use, accepted-generation changes, or Forge/Runtime integration.
reset_restart: Compare exact neural state/tape roundtrip with same model identity, scope, codec and event count; reject incompatible restores. Re-query must not advance the event clock or mutate temporal state.
perturbations: Paired latent Gaussian corruption is tested for the GRU only and explicitly not a representation-matched Transformer comparison. A subsequent valid WRITE tests recovery. Shared observation substitutions and distractor changes test source use.
decision_limits: Cannot establish broad reasoning improvements, native tri-core superiority, language competence, production readiness or target-device efficiency. A saturated depth curve calls for a harder refinement task, not a declaration that recurrence is useless.

amendment.basis: Development seed101, 300-step GRU/Transformer/soft-gated runs, retained in evidence/development with pre-run source hashes. Long-delay soft memory failed despite short-horizon competence.
changes: Add learned hard-gated persistent-state candidate using straight-through gradient surrogate.
Add Transformer + hand-engineered exact-memory tool using the SAME Transformer weights; strong memory control, not learned compression.
Use portable 5ms process RSS sampler; exact allocator peaks remain unmeasured.
amendment.timing: BEFORE pilot seeds201..205. This is an adaptive development pilot, not a confirmatory architecture test.

source_of_hard_gate: Proposed engineering variant for this study; standard straight-through surrogate, not a novelty claim and not low-bit learning state.
gate_rule: Soft: h=(1-g)*h+g*v, g=sigmoid(learned affine event embedding). Hard: forward g=1[g>=0.5], sigmoid-gradient surrogate. Value and gate are learned only from training labels.
